How do I use it properly the very first time?

Sent · Just now

Chilly's Agent · AI

Chilly's Agent · AI says:

To use your Chilly’s product properly the very first time, follow these basics:

Wash all parts first with hot, soapy water (hand‑wash; don’t soak for long, and most items are not dishwasher safe).
Assemble correctly (fit lids, collars, retainers, or straws exactly as instructed before filling).
Check liquid type and temperature:
Don’t use carbonated drinks or dry ice in Food Pots or bottles not rated for fizz.
Don’t fill above 90°C / 194°F, and be extra careful with hot drinks.
Don’t close some coffee lids or shake bottles/cups when liquids are very hot.
Keep upright when advised: Flip Lids, Sports Lids, Coffee Cups, and Switch Cups are spill‑resistant, not guaranteed 100% leak‑proof, so carry them upright.
No microwave, freezer, or dishwasher for bottles, coffee cups, food pots, Series 2 Flip, Series 2 Switch, or Series 3 Bottles.
Clean regularly after use; for a deeper clean, you can use bicarbonate of soda/baking powder with water.

If you tell us which Chilly’s product you have (Bottle, Flip, Coffee Cup, Food Pot, Cutlery, etc.), we can walk you through the exact first‑use steps for that item.
